text_block_list.text: "People whose personalities just don't match no matter what" do exist.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
A Tracen Academy specialty: the mock tournament.
The opponent in the finals is...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: You again, Tsuzuki?

text_block_list.name: Tsuzuki Reigning
text_block_list.text: That's my line. I can't just let someone like you run rampant.

text_block_list.name: Tsuzuki Reigning
text_block_list.text:
Such barbarism deviates from Tracen Academy's mainstream...
I will defeat them today so that no one takes after them.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Silence, you small fry. I'm sick to death
of your petty little schemes anyway.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: If that's how it is, I'll bury you at the bottom of the turf instead!

text_block_list.name: Pocket & Tsudzuki
text_block_list.text:
RAAAAAAGH!
HAAAAAAAAGH!

text_block_list.name: Pocket & Tsudzuki
text_block_list.text:
Get off the track!
Disappear!

text_block_list.name: Pocket & Tsudzuki
text_block_list.text:
Daaammnnn iiiit!!
You fools!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Wah... Those two finished one-two
in the mock race again, huh...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
When those two team up, they're unstoppable.
Pokke's sheer fighting spirit combined with Tsudzuki's brains... there's just no opening to exploit.
And several months passed since the Debut—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
You're late, Tsuzuki!
Didn't I say we were gonna practice together after school today?!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
You're treating me to a triple-scoop ice cream on the way home.
And then you're letting me copy your homework.

text_block_list.name: Tsuzuki Reigning
text_block_list.text:
Hmph, if you want sugar, use your own brain to think.
Otherwise, an idiot will just stay an idiot.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
It's fine!
Doing the thinking is your damn job, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Tsuzuki Reigning
text_block_list.text:
Be independent, child.
I am not your guardian.
Something seemed off about her.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: What's up, partner? You've got a puzzled look on your face.
choice_data_list: Are you two getting along better now?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
With who?! As if I'd partner with her!
Before I take on Tachyon, I'm definitely gonna make her cry!

text_block_list.name: Tsuzuki Reigning
text_block_list.text:
Hmph, that's my line.
Besides, I'm the one who's going to surpass Tachyon.

text_block_list.name: Tsuzuki Reigning
text_block_list.text: "Besides, what is it with you? You criticize my strategies, yet lately you've been imitating them quite often."

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Look who's talking, you're the one getting swept along by my intensity.

text_block_list.name: Pocket & Tsudzuki
text_block_list.text:
RRYAAAAAAH!!
HAAAAAAAAAAAH!!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Ha, my win again today!

text_block_list.name: Tsuzuki Reigning
text_block_list.text: Heh, they were too weak to be worth finishing off.
choice_data_list: Here, drinks for both of you!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Oh, thanks! I'll take the big one!

text_block_list.name: Tsuzuki Reigning
text_block_list.text: A bottle's a bottle, size doesn't matter.

Their running styles were polar opposites, which is precisely why they learned so much.
Sparks flying as they clashed, the two pushed each other to grow stronger.
Then, one day――

text_block_list.name: Tsuzuki Reigning
text_block_list.text:
What's up, Pokke? Staring at the sunset like that.
That's not like you.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Shut up.
I was just lost in thought.

text_block_list.name: Tsuzuki Reigning
text_block_list.text: Lost in thought?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Tsuzuki, since we started going at it,
it just kinda occurred to me.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Tracen Academy...
I barged into a turf where I don't belong, but in the end, it's just like "back then."

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
WOOOOOOH!!
Tokyo is CONQUEREEEEEED!!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"How's that, how's my running?!
With this, I can—"

text_block_list.name: Hokkaido Coach
text_block_list.text: Not yet.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Huh...? But there's no one on this turf
who can beat me...

text_block_list.name: Hokkaido Coach
text_block_list.text:
You're No. 1 here. But if you're aiming to be
the best in Tokyo, that physique won't cut it.

text_block_list.name: Hokkaido Coach
text_block_list.text:
"If you're serious about taking Tokyo, I'll train you.
All of you. After that—it comes down to your mindset."

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Heh... Fine by me. Teach me, then—
the pro running you know all about.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
*wheeze*... *pant*... That's rough...
But not yet, I ain't dropping dead from just this.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
You lot! We're taking it no matter what!!
The title of Tokyo's best is right before our eyes!!!

text_block_list.name: Companions
text_block_list.text: WOOOOOOH!!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
“—It's the same.
Only Tokyo was swapped for Tachyon. And—”

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: The people hanging around you... became your entourage, Tsuzuki.

text_block_list.name: Tsuzuki Reigning
text_block_list.text:
Heh, *you're* the follower, Pocket.
Despite how I look, I am the daughter of an entrepreneur, after all.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Huh, who do we have here? Some rich young lady?
Figures.

text_block_list.name: Tsuzuki Reigning
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I was raised to stand above others.
Therefore—

text_block_list.name: Tsuzuki Reigning
text_block_list.text:
Aiming for the top. I agree with that.
No matter what, I must defeat Tachyon
and claim the Classic Triple Crown.

text_block_list.name: Tsuzuki Reigning
text_block_list.text:
"The opponent is strong. Even combining my wits and your explosive power,
we might not be able to overcome them..."

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: We're gonna surpass it! Me and you both. And then—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Tachyon ain't the only one I'm gonna beat.
Having you take it from me pisses me off the most!

text_block_list.name: Tsuzuki Reigning
text_block_list.text: Haha, no doubt about it. At Nakayama, at Tokyo, at Kyoto—I'll make you submit.

text_block_list.name: Tsuzuki Reigning
text_block_list.text: "For that reason, I can't afford to put on a pathetic showing in the year-end Junior GI."

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah. So, Tsuzuki, what about you?
I talked with my partner, and we're aiming for the Hopeful Stakes.

text_block_list.name: Tsuzuki Reigning
text_block_list.text: I'm going for the Asahi Hai FS.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Heh, I see, you're choosing the mile races.
Then unless I make a surprise entry,
our showdown will have to wait.

text_block_list.name: Tsuzuki Reigning
text_block_list.text: Yeah, that'll have to wait until the Satsuki Sho.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
—Don't you dare lose, got it?
Not until I beat the crap out of you in a GⅠ.

text_block_list.name: Tsuzuki Reigning
text_block_list.text: Same to you. Only if both of us keep winning in peak condition will there be the faintest glimmer of a chance in the Satsuki Sho.

text_block_list.name: Tsuzuki Reigning
text_block_list.text:
"Defeat Tachyon.
We're definitely going to pull it off, Pokke."

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
You don't even need to say it. The two of us'll take 'em on!
And I'm gonna win!

text_block_list.name: Tsuzuki Reigning
text_block_list.text: No, I will win.

text_block_list.name: Pocket & Tsudzuki
text_block_list.text:
It's me!
It's me.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Heh, what a drag, sheesh!

text_block_list.name: Tsuzuki Reigning
text_block_list.text: Back at you.

And so, their paths diverged:
the Hopeful Stakes and the Asahi Hai FS.

Until the day we cross paths at the Satsuki Sho,
we both have to get stronger.
Much, much stronger than we are now.
